name: Reel Empire: Idle Tycoon
subtitle: Build a Fishing Harbour
promotionalText: Start with one rowboat and build a fishing empire across six waters. 96 species, a crew to sign on, a weekend derby, and no ads. Ever.
description:
Start with one rowboat on a quiet lake and build a fishing empire.

Catch fish, haul them up the dock, clean and pack them in the hall, and sell them at the market. Hire skippers so the harbour runs by itself, come back to a full till, and grow from an old jetty to a fleet working six waters, from Stillwater Lake to the Arctic.

NO FORCED ADS
Crew chests and a daily gift come free on a timer. An advert only plays when you ask for one: for a second double of the day or a Tide Boost.

THE WHOLE HARBOUR ON ONE SCREEN
• Boats, dock hands, the processing hall and the market trucks, all at work in a bright 3D harbour
• The weakest stage glows so you always know what to upgrade next
• Levels 10, 25, 50 and 100 double a berth

96 SPECIES TO CATCH
• A species book for every water, from Bluegill to the Greenland Shark
• Some fish only bite at night, in the rain, in a storm or in one season
• Mount your rare catches in the trophy hall for a lasting bonus

RUN IT YOUR WAY
• Fresh, cleaned, filleted, smoked or canned: choose what the hall makes, and watch the market's favourite of the day
• Sign on a crew of twelve and put your best hands on duty
• Send a spare boat on voyages and unload it when it's back
• Renovate a harbour to start again at double income, and open the next water

ALWAYS SOMETHING NEW
• A daily gift and three daily tasks
• A weekend derby with goals and a prize table
• A four-week season with thirty tiers of rewards
• Game Center leaderboards and achievements

YOUR HARBOUR, EVERYWHERE
• Earn while you're away
• Your save follows you through iCloud
• Optional Sign in with Apple; purchases restore on any device

Reel Empire is free to play. It offers optional in-app purchases: gems, one-time upgrades kept for good, and a Season Pass. Crew chests show their odds before you open one.
